## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF: Defensive bias with weak sector breadth (Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive) supported by defensive outperformance (Healthcare & Consumer Staples up) and overall sector weakness in cyclicals and tech; Leadership: Moderate concentration (Top 5 span 3 sectors). Confirmations: defensive names (JNJ, PFE, EL) ABOVE TREND and sector breadth ≤6/11.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.97% | 1M: +9.95%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing strength: EOG (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +5.20%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +12.95%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: AMD (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND, CRM still ABOVE TREND but tech overall weak. Industrials weak: HON (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -12.07%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND. Utilities weakest: VST (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -19.39%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership concentrated around Materials/Healthcare/Staples (3 sectors represented).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -9.82% | 1M: -4.11%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -19.39%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND, HON (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -12.07%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Tech, Utilities and select Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence in big-cap tech where MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) is in CORRECTION and NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) in CORRECTION — tactical caution.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed-to-negative with net selling: NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION, AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY; sector 1W: -1.85% and tech showing rotation away from growth leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are soft on the week: JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION, V (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +5.73%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +9.49%) ABOVE TREND — sector 1W: -2.01% with mixed internals, so no broad financial leadership despite pockets of strength.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive leadership evident: JNJ (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +4.23%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +14.20%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W: +3.76% and showing confirmation of RISK-OFF defensive bid.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor defensive and selective cyclicals: emphasize Healthcare (JNJ, MRK, DHR) and high-quality Materials/Energy (FCX, NEM, COP) while reducing exposure to weak Tech names showing CORRECTION/BELOW TREND. Style: Value/Defensive tilt given RISK-OFF and concentrated leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND — momentum and confirmation; FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND — headline-driven downside; AMD (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND — trend risk.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (Breadth contributing to risk-off defensive tone; sector 1W: +3.76%). BEARISH: Technology and Utilities (Tech 1W: -1.85%, Utilities 1W: -4.00%) — monitor for continued outflows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA 1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85% (CORRECTION) — watch near recent 1M consolidation resistance for trend failure. AAPL 1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74% (RECOVERY) — watch support area as potential inflection. JPM 1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48% (CORRECTION) — monitor weekly close below breakout level for extended weakness. FCX 1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72% (ABOVE TREND) — watch for momentum continuation on volume.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
AAPL (+80): Largest-ever buyback headline; AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY — sentiment confirmed by a small bounce. DE (+80): Deere (DE) positive revision; DE not in SP100 top list here but sector industrials may take signals; cross-check with industrial weakness (DE could be a relative bright spot). CL (+80): Colgate (CL) — CL likely confirmed by staples strength; CL positioning aligns with defensive bid.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
TSLA (-75): Recall headline; TSLA (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +13.50%) ABOVE TREND — notable divergence: negative news but price strength suggests distribution risk to monitor. INTC (-50): Stock sale headline; INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND — news confirmed by sharp price weakness. AVGO (-55): Broadcom negative headline; check for tech spillover as AVGO likely under pressure alongside other semis in CORRECTION.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Value/Defensive style. Healthcare and Materials showing relative strength (MRK ABOVE TREND, FCX ABOVE TREND) while Tech shows CORRECTION signals (NVDA CORRECTION, MSFT CORRECTION). Key risk: major-cap tech divergence and headline-driven weakness in INTC/AMD — monitor for trend breaks and sentiment-confirmation.
